decision: Consider a bounded existing grouped-kernel experiment, not a same-rank-only reuse kernel
source_evidence: The current multi-token MMVQ kernel assigns one token per warp and an expert rank per block; it does not regroup matching experts across ranks
limitations: The callback segments graph execution and synchronizes readback, so timings are not benchmark results
Expert-selection duplication is not measured DRAM traffic; cache reuse may already avoid physical reloads
These are two existing development prompts, not representative independent quality validation
Single-sequence observations do not validate rollback or multi-sequence execution
warmup_note: An additional two-token MTP initialization probe runs outside the model warmup flag. It is identified before request launch and excluded.
prefill_note: The four-token prompt tail is excluded; full prompt and draft/accepted/generated token accounting reconciles exactly.
